document.name: Tutu School Upper East Side
document.address: 1195 Lexington Avenue, Upper East Side, NY 10028
document.shortDescription: Story-driven ballet classes on the Upper East Side for children ages 6 months to 8 years, with a published schedule across weekdays and weekends.
document.longDescription:
Tutu School Upper East Side offers story-driven ballet classes for children ages 6 months to 8 years. The official home and classes pages list Baby Ballet for 6-18 months, Tutu Toddlers for 18 months to 3 years, Exploring Ballet for ages 3-5, and Primary Ballet Prep for ages 5-8.

The official classes page says registration is ongoing and that class membership is charged in installment payments of $180.00 on the 1st of each month. The same page publishes classes Monday through Sunday, with examples including Monday morning classes from 9:30 a.m. to 12:15 p.m., weekday after-school and afternoon-evening slots from 3:00 p.m. to 5:45 p.m., and weekend classes on both Saturday and Sunday.

The official site lists the studio at 1195 Lexington Avenue on the Upper East Side, and the public contact number on the page is 917-794-4975. This listing uses the monthly membership figure as a planning price because the official page does not publish one standardized per-class rate.

Sources: https://tutuschool.com/ues/ https://tutuschool.com/ues/classes/ https://tutuschool.com/ues/wp-content/uploads/sites/114/2025/03/hero-classes-scaled.jpg
document.announcementDescription: The official class page shows morning, afternoon, after-school, and evening ballet classes across Monday through Sunday.
